name: Einride
sub: Cabless electric freight pods with a Nasdaq listing (ENRD)
about: Electric and autonomous freight company using cabless pods, connected electric trucks and logistics software. Their autonomy is important but integrated into a broader freight platform.
model: Freight capacity, electric truck operations, software platform, and autonomous vehicle deployments.
deployment: Electric truck operations and autonomous Pod pilots in selected logistics environments.
metrics: Included because purpose-built autonomous freight vehicles sit between trucking platform and fleet operations.
signal: Einride is a differentiated freight platform because they pair vehicle design, charging, and logistics orchestration.

sources.title: Autonomous EV freight trucking company Einride rises sharply in first trade on Nasdaq
